blocks.text: Match preview: New South Wales face Queensland in 13th Match (TEST) on Sun, 22 Nov, 2026, 5:00 am at Sydney Cricket Ground Sydney. Full pitch report, weather forecast, and squad details below.
Pace and bounce typical of Australian wickets; good carry for fast bowlers.
Rain showers · High 28°C / Low 18°C · Rain: 3.9 mm · Wind: up to 18 km/h. Rain likely — DLS may apply; favour bowlers who hit the deck and teams with depth.
International playing XI is announced at the toss. Check back on match day for confirmed line-ups.
